subject: AWS Marketplace listing launch: page copy, co-sell asks & collateral
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell interest

Hi Rafael,

We looked at Redwood as part of our ML infra shortlist and liked the predictable inference offering. Our GTM team asked whether we can list on AWS Marketplace and pursue a co-sell conversation with AWS. Can you share an overview of what you need from us to get the product page live, and any seller/collateral you recommend for the co-sell review?

Key questions:
- Typical timeline from asset handoff to listing publish?
- What copy assets do you need (hero, bullets, pricing sample)?
- Is there a standard playbook for co-sell enablement we can review?

Happy to set up a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Sophie Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Analytics
[sophie.park@acme-analytics.com]

[Attachment: acme_current-offerings.pdf (PDF, 280KB)]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell interest

Hi Sophie — great to hear from you and glad Acme is evaluating this. Short answers up front: 4–6 weeks typical for a first listing (depending on AMI/AMI-less assets and PrivateOffer needs), we need a hero line, 3–5 benefit bullets, a short product summary, pricing guidance (list vs private offer), and two collateral pieces: a one-pager and a technical deployment guide.

I attached our marketplace one-pager and a checklist for what we usually ask partners to provide. Can we lock a 30min sync Thursday to walk through the handoff? I also looped in Marissa (partner marketing) and Kimberly (marketplace program lead) to review copy and co-sell requirements.

Proposed next steps:
- You: share hero suggestion + 1-paragraph summary + target pricing approach
- Us: draft marketplace page + co-sell playbook draft
- Joint: review with your AM (if you have one) and schedule co-sell kickoff with AWS

Attachment: [redwood_marketplace_one-pager.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager — Cloud Partners
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: FW: AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell interest (Acme) — copy & entitlements review

Marissa / Kimberly / Ben — forwarding Sophie from Acme. She asked for requirements and we promised a draft. I sketched a hero + bullets below (quick & rough) and attached a more complete proposed copy file. Please review and flag any legal/price footnote or entitlement asks we should surface to Acme before we send the draft.

Quick hero (draft):
"Redwood Inference — predictable, production-grade LLM inference at cloud scale"

Benefit bullets (draft):
- Consistent sub-100ms p95 inference for common LLM workloads (latency depends on model/seq)
- Dedicated and private deployment options for regulated data and predictable capacity
- Built-in cost controls: adaptive batching, KV-cache, and quantization profiles to lower per-token spend
- Observability and rollouts: per-route tracing, cost breakdowns, and canary rollouts

Notes / asks:
- Pricing footnote: do we call out per-1000 token pricing or refer to contact for PrivateOffer?
- Entitlement mapping: will we need to map AMI SKUs vs. metered usage? Acme mentioned they prefer trial activations for key teams.

Attachment: [proposed_aws_page_copy.md (Markdown, 12KB)]

Thanks — please reply inline with edits. Rafael

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-21T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell interest (Acme) — copy & entitlements review

Thanks Rafael — looked through the draft. High level edits below (I edited proposed_aws_page_copy.md and left comments in the Drive link):

Hero suggestion tweak:
"Predictable LLM inference for product teams — low latency, predictable cost, flexible deployment"

Bullets (tone + customer-centric examples):
- Sub-100ms p95 for common tasks (e.g., chat, classification) — helps product teams keep interactive SLAs
- Dedicated GPU pools for steady throughput and enterprise SLAs (ideal for regulated workloads)
- Intelligent batching & caching to reduce per-token cost by up to 3x for repeat prompts
- Built-in observability: per-model token cost breakdowns, tracing, and rollback controls

Pricing footnote: call out a public list price for hosted inference and then add "Contact us for Dedicated or Private pricing / PrivateOffer". That keeps the page self-serve while surfacing enterprise motion.

Entitlements / trial flow:
- Recommend a 30-day trial entitlement with metered tokens (sample SKU for trial). If the customer requests AMI/private install we recommend PrivateOffer.

I also drafted a short co-sell one-pager focused on partner enablement. See Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/shared/marketplace-assets/ACME (comments invited).

[Attachment referenced: co-sell-playbook-draft.docx (DOCX, 64KB)]

Marissa
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, Redwood

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-22T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell interest (Acme) — copy & entitlements review

All — looks good to me. A few program-level checks before we send to Acme:
- Confirm AMI vs metered SKU decision (Marissa's trial SKU option is fine; if Acme wants AMI image, provisioning & support notes must be explicit)
- Legal: include a short data residency/control blurb on the page (we can add a single line under bullets)
- Co-sell: confirm whether the customer has an assigned AWS Partner SA/AM — that will speed the co-sell kickoff.

I approved the copy edits in Drive. Rafael — please pull the attached one-pager and the edited page copy into a single packet and send to Sophie with the checklist below. I'll join the kickoff once we have dates.

Quick checklist to send Acme:
1) Hero + 1-paragraph product summary (we'll propose edits)
2) 3–5 benefit bullets (finalized)
3) Preferred pricing model (public metered list + PrivateOffer option)
4) Preferred trial entitlement (30-day metered SKU or AMI trial)
5) Contact details for your AWS AM/SA (if available)
6) Any compliance/regulatory notes (data residency)

Kimberly
Program Lead, AWS Marketplace, Redwood

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing + co-sell interest — next steps + assets needed

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the quick response earlier. Per our internal review we pulled together a short launch packet and next-step checklist. Please find the items below and a couple of asks so we can produce the marketplace page and initiate co-sell: 

Required from Acme (requested by EOD Monday):
- Hero suggestion + 1-paragraph product summary (one sentence + 2–3 lines)
- 3–5 customer-focused benefit bullets (we can edit)
- Preferred pricing approach (public metered list price OR interest in PrivateOffer)
- Trial preference: 30-day metered trial SKU or AMI-based trial
- AWS AM/SA contact (if you have an assigned partner rep)
- Any compliance/regulatory callouts for the product page (data residency, encryption at rest notes)

What we attached for your review:
- redwood_marketplace_one-pager.pdf (partner-facing overview)
- proposed_aws_page_copy.md (draft marketplace copy with Marissa/Kimberly edits)
- co-sell-playbook-draft.docx (partner enablement playbook)

Links and next steps:
- Shared Drive with editable copy and comments: https://drive.redwood.com/s/shared/marketplace-assets/ACME
- AWS Seller registration (if you need it): https://sellercentral.amazon.com/offer/registration/ACME-REDWOOD

If you can send the hero + bullets and pricing preference by COB Monday, we will produce a first-pass marketplace page and schedule a 30-min review (we'll include our AM/SA and your AM if available). After page sign-off we'll request co-sell kickoff with AWS.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this quickly.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager — Cloud Partners
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

[Attachments sent: redwood_marketplace_one-pager.pdf; proposed_aws_page_copy.md; co-sell-playbook-draft.docx]
